ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.9.4 Tail Focus
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.9.4 Tail Focus for RimWorld 1.5. Keeps the V0.9.3 consolidated stable core and ReachProfile V0.4.18 unchanged, adds lightweight JobGiver search-tail buckets, authority-safe HaulMerge cheap-negative pruning inside the existing S4 rescue, and acceleration-only cold sleep for the zero-yield Persistent GenClosest consumer. V25 JobGiver negative memo, V19-V21 ReachProfile experiments, resident hot-path profilers, PathSnapshot and WorkPrefilter remain excluded.
